purpose.summary: This program transfers/migrates data from one company/branch (empresa/filial) database to another for the EFD343.CAD file (relac-estrutura-contabil — accounting structure relationship table). It reads records from a source indexed file, remaps company and branch codes, and writes them to a destination indexed file, with diagnostic mode support and logging.
